versions.change: First release of AXI specification v1.0
First release of AXI specification v2.0
Public beta draft — first ACE description
First release of AMBA AXI and ACE Protocol Specification
Second release of AMBA AXI and ACE Protocol Specification

backward_compat_traps.axi3: AxLEN[3:0] — Burst_Length = AxLEN[3:0] + 1; burst length 1-16 transfers for all burst types
backward_compat_traps.axi4: AxLEN[7:0] — Burst_Length = AxLEN[7:0] + 1; INCR up to 256; FIXED/WRAP still 1-16
backward_compat_traps.trap: AXI3 master + AXI4 slave (or vice versa) without burst-length translation: AXI3 master can never request more than 16-beat bursts but AXI4 slave default registers may decode the upper bits as junk.
Locked-access semantics silently dropped when AXI3 master targets AXI4 slave.

backward_compat_traps.axi3: BVALID may precede AW handshake (depends only on W handshake + WLAST).
backward_compat_traps.axi4: BVALID may only be asserted after BOTH (AW handshake AND W handshake with WLAST=1).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Straight AXI3-on-AXI4 wrapper must serialise; otherwise AXI4 slave may stall waiting for AW that the wrapper has not yet propagated.

backward_compat_traps.axi4: AxQOS (4 bits) + AxREGION (4 bits) sideband added.
backward_compat_traps.trap: AXI3 sources must tie AxQOS/AxREGION to 0; otherwise default-slave decode behavior is implementation-defined.

backward_compat_traps.axi4: AxCACHE[3:0] bit semantics reinterpreted ('Cacheable' renamed 'Modifiable' etc.).
backward_compat_traps.trap: Blind passthrough creates subtle correctness bugs; memory attribute interpretation must be re-validated at AXI3↔AXI4 boundary.

fields.version_naming_history_note: AXI specification versions v1.0 and v2.0 (used in Issues B and C) have been discontinued to avoid confusion with AXI3 / AXI4. Issue E.a was originally published before Issue F; AXI5 introduced in Issue G (2021).
fields.ic_name: AMBA AXI / ACE Protocol Specification (ARM IHI 0022E)
fields.spec_version_ahb: AMBA AHB Protocol Specification ARM IHI 0033C (15 September 2021)
fields.spec_version_apb: AMBA APB Protocol Specification ARM IHI 0024C (13 April 2010) v2.0

versions_ahb.change: Update for AMBA 5 AHB Protocol Specification (Confidential).
Signal width properties; Write strobes; User signaling update; Signal validity rules; Interface protection using parity. Regularized terminology to Manager / Subordinate.

versions_apb.change: Second release for APB v1.0 — adds PREADY, PSLVERR (APB3).
First release for APB v2.0 — adds PPROT and PSTRB (APB4).

fields.version_naming_history_note_ahb: AHB-Lite (single-Manager) first defined in Issue A (2006). Issue B introduced AHB5 = AHB-Lite + optional Secure / Exclusive / Extended memory / User / Parity features. Issue C (2021) regularized Master/Slave to Manager/Subordinate.
fields.version_naming_history_note_apb: APB2 (AMBA 2) defined original two-phase interface. APB3 (2004) added PREADY + PSLVERR. APB4 (2010) added PPROT + PSTRB. APB Rev E (1998) is obsolete.
interoperability_summary: AHB-Lite Manager interfaces a wider AHB5 Subordinate by leaving the AHB5-specific signal inputs at safe defaults (HEXCL=0, HNONSEC=0, HWSTRB=all-ones).
APB4 Manager interfaces an APB3 Subordinate by tying off PPROT + PSTRB at the Subordinate input (or the bridge does not generate them).
An AHB5 Subordinate interfaces an AHB-Lite Manager by treating absent optional signals as their defaults.

ace_lifecycle.subsequent_releases_outside_this_doc: Issues F (2017) and onwards added AXI5/ACE5 variants in IHI 0022F/G/H (not covered by IHI 0022E).

ace_added_signals_vs_AXI4: AW channel: AWDOMAIN[1:0], AWSNOOP[2:0], AWBAR[1:0], AWUNIQUE
R  channel: RRESP extended from [1:0] to [3:0]
B  channel: BRESP extended from [1:0] to [2:0]

backward_compat_considerations.ace: Required on AR/AW; AXI4-only masters tie to Non-shareable / 0.

backward_compat_considerations.ace_full: Required for cached masters; ACE-Lite omits.

backward_compat_considerations.ace: Required; single-cycle pulse after R/B handshake.

interoperability_matrix.notes: Master treated as ACE-Lite at AxDOMAIN=Non-shareable.
No snoop infrastructure; cannot maintain coherency.
